poses.caption: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders, feet together and hips level.
Jump both feet apart, then back together. Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising or sagging.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1478 JACK PLANK. TWO equal square cells side by side wide2:1 same full body person same camera scale. HIGH front-side three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT, viewpoint enough overhead to clearly see foot WIDTH. High plank BOTH palms flat under shoulders fingers spread forward, BOTH elbows straight, long neutral line head shoulders hips ankles, pelvis level no pike or sag, head gaze down neck neutral. LEFT START legs straight FEET TOGETHER side-by-side, toes/balls support floor. RIGHT WIDE LANDING after jumping feet apart: BOTH straight legs spread symmetrically laterally WIDE about2x shoulder width in V from pelvis, BOTH toes/balls grounded, heel elevated. HANDS/shoulders/torso/hips EXACT same position/height both poses, only feet separated. Show full two separate hands feet and all limbs, no extra limbs. PRIMARY ABS diffuse RED tint over intact BLACK tank front/lateral abdominal waist ONLY, not chest shoulders glutes. Cloth opaque smooth natural broad folds, NO abdominal segments or muscle striations through fabric. Fine detailed grayscale EXPOSED anatomy realistic fingers proportions feet. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK covering waist, black MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH continuous hems seams real broad folds no cutaways/transparency. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft floor contact shadows generous12percent margins head hands heels widest feet all fully within EACH square no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore bench chest highlight. No text captions labels arrows extra people.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two jack plank candidates, four poses, two built-in calls. Feet together to wide symmetric landing with same planted hands and extended arms, covered abdominal red tint and full opaque clothes. Exposed grayscale anatomy retained. Qualified lumbar/pelvic level, shoulder over wrist alignment, wide-stance ankle/toe orientation, wrist pressure and cloth tint require human review. Static start/landing artwork and external captions describe jumping; no airborne phase claimed. Original project artwork rendering style only, no upstream licensed input. Exact prompts/originals saved. No anatomical or clothing approval or publication. Seven pipeline checks do not establish anatomical accuracy.
